items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: Well, I remember we had a band, a kazut band. I used to play piano, he played drum

ctx.x: Lester, Alexa. Lester, Alexa. Well, I remember we had a band, a kazut band. I used to play piano, he played drum, and another boy called Albert played a kazut, was in the form of a trumpet.
